'''Thanatizine II''' was a second generation drug of [[Thanatizine]]. [[Cronal]] used it on beings that came into his presence in his [[Shadow Base|base]] on [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]].

A being in full Thanatizine II suspension would not have to breathe but once an hour.
